_doc: Edge-envelope SpecPIM baseline aligned with AHASPro.md Table 2. Two HBM2 channels at 800 MHz emulate the paired 'NPU side 51.2 GB/s LPDDR5 off-chip' + 'PIM-enabled LPDDR5 channel' view implied by Table 2, and pim_channel_stride=2 marks one of them as PIM-enabled. AAU fusion is on because SpecPIM does accelerate attention on PIM; AHASD's adaptive stack (EDC/TVC/GTSU) stays off. Used to replace the previous specpim cell at edge scale.
